```yaml
name: Coverage Badge

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  coverage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pytest coverage

      - name: Run tests with coverage
        run: |
          coverage run -m pytest
          coverage json -o coverage.json

      - name: Calculate coverage percentage
        id: calc
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          with open('coverage.json') as f:
              data = json.load(f)
          percent = data['totals']['percent_covered']
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a') as f:
              f.write(f"percent={percent:.2f}\n")
          PY

      - name: Generate coverage badge
        run: |
          coverage=${{ steps.calc.outputs.percent }}
          curl -L "https://img.shields.io/badge/coverage-${coverage}%25-brightgreen.svg" -o coverage.svg

      - name: Commit badge
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@04702edda442b2e678b25b537cec683a1493fcb9
        with:
          commit_message: "Update coverage badge"
          file_pattern: coverage.svg
```
